original: Holds 2048 kE of Echo. Charge it at an Echo charging station (slots marked with a down arrow), drain it into a base grid (up arrow) - this is how energy is carried between bases and handed to other players. Powers future Echo gear.

original: Two cold fusion cells soldered into one unit. Never runs out. Goes into its own socket on the exoskeleton servo drive in place of both cells, so Echo cells cannot be fitted next to it. Powers Echo gear only: cold fusion cannot be poured into other carriers or a base grid, so charging stations do not take it.
